about: Phase 4 shared Dart/Kotlin fixture (plan §8, BLOCK-2): live rep paces are untrimmed lap distance / lap moving time, with lap edges interpolated in the recorder distance stream at the lap time. Laps end 0.4 s after a sample. run_pre_lv0 stores lap distances one sample late (the #26 manual-lap lag); the figures must not change. Kotlin LiveCompare must reproduce expected to 0.1 m and 0.1 s/km.
